query:
UPDATE media_comment c
        SET deleted_at = NOW()
        WHERE c.id = $1
          AND c.media_id = $2
          AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (
              c.author_id = $3
              OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM user_media m
                  WHERE m.id = c.media_id AND m.user_id = $3
              )
          )
